items.title: CPI, Cisco earnings, and more: What investors need to watch Wednesday
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host, Josh Lipton previews what investors should watch on Wednesday, August 12, including the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which will offer a fresh look at inflation and the health of the consumer. Cisco (CSCO) reports fiscal fourth-quarter results, while Bloomin' Brands (BLMN) also reports earnings.

items.title: Cisco (CSCO) Puts 90,000 Workers On Personalized AI Agents With New Revenue Targets
items.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS: CSCO) is rolling out personalized AI agents to its entire 90,000-person workforce as part of a broad internal transformation. The company is pairing the deployment with major infrastructure investment and company-wide model routing to manage AI workloads across teams and functions. items.title: Cisco or Coherent: Which Stock Is Poised to Soar After Earnings?
items.summary: Cisco and Coherent both report earnings the same afternoon, putting two very different AI networking bets head to head. One carries a 93% crowd-backed beat probability while the other just shed 14% in a single session, and only one belongs in a retirement portfolio.
